int bwl::nl80211::sta_wlan_hal_nl80211::add_network ( )
private

Adds a new network.

Executes wpa_supplicant command ADD_NETWORK to create new network with empty configuration. The new network is disabled and once it has been configured it can be enabled with ENABLE_NETWORK command.

Returns
Network ID of the new network or -1 on failure.

◆ set_network()

bool bwl::nl80211::sta_wlan_hal_nl80211::set_network ( int  network_id,
const std::string &  param,
const std::string &  value 
)
private

Sets a network variable.

Executes wpa_supplicant command SET_NETWORK to set a network variable value.

This command uses the same variables and data formats as the wpa_supplicant configuration file. Examples:

  • ssid (network name, SSID)
  • psk (WPA passphrase or pre-shared key)
  • key_mgmt (key management protocol)
  • identity (EAP identity)
  • password (EAP password)
  • ...
Parameters
network_idNetwork ID of the network whose variable to set.
paramName of the variable.
valueValue to set.
Returns
True on success and false otherwise.

bool bwl::nl80211::sta_wlan_hal_nl80211::set_network_params ( int  network_id,
const std::string &  ssid,
const std::string &  bssid,
WiFiSec  sec,
bool  mem_only_psk,
const std::string &  pass,
bool  hidden_ssid,
int  freq = 0 
)
private

Configures a network.

Configures a newly added network before it can be enabled.

Parameters
network_idNetwork ID of the network to be configured.
ssidService Set Identifier (network name).
bssidBasic Service Set Identifier.
secWLAN Security Type (converted to a key management protocol).
mem_only_pskKeep PSK/passphrase only in memory.
passWPA ASCII passphrase. If this is set, PSK will be generated using the SSID and passphrase configured for the network. ASCII passphrase must be between 8 and 63 characters (inclusive).
hidden_ssidScan this SSID with Probe Requests (scan_ssid can be used to scan for APs using hidden SSIDs).
freqFrequency in MHz to allow for selecting the BSS. If 0, all frequencies are considered when selecting a BSS.
Returns
True on success and false otherwise.
